measurement: MEAS, lead-run browser evaluation; not rerun by the web builder
revision_note: Measured before the terrain-blending refinement; exact deployed hash was not recorded in the evaluation.
viewport_note: The browser-open request specified 1280×800; the tool's screenshot record reports an original capture of 1280×657.
walking_input: Hold W for the walking measurement, then release it
measurement_expression: new Promise(res => { let n = 0; const t0 = performance.now(); function f() { n++; if (performance.now() - t0 < 6000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else res(+(n / ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000)).toFixed(1)); } requestAnimationFrame(f); })
scope: Two short requestAnimationFrame measurements, not a physical-phone test or an all-device performance claim. Frame-by-frame timings were not retained.
